title: Mordheim KB warband — band.yaml
description: Canonical identity and roster frame of one warband: who it is, which collection and grade it belongs to, its editorial sources and the size, gold and member limits of its roster. Shared definitions live in defs.schema.json.

schema_version.description: Document schema version. Exactly 2 for the current editorial contract.

id.description: Band id, equal to the directory name and stable across the KB.

canonical_family.description: Family the band belongs to when several printings share a warband (e.g. `amazons` groups `amazons-lustria` and `amazons-mordheim`).

original_locale.description: Locale the warband was published in (`en`, `es`).

ruleset.description: Ruleset the band plays under; the collection registry must allow it.

categories.description: Grade or staging labels the band is published under (`core`, `1a`, `1b`, `1c`, `trollheim`, …).

grade.description: Editorial grade of the band. The Trollheim collection carries no grade and stores null.

publication.description: Publication the band was printed in, as labelled by the source.

status.description: Editorial status of the transcription. Currently `source-normalized`.

sources.description: Editorial sources of the band record.

rule_ids.description: Band-level rules of `special-rules.yaml` that apply to the warband as a whole; they must resolve to declared rule ids.

variants.description: Variant-capable warbands (Reikland, Middenheim, Marienburg, Ostermark, bloodlines …) declare each choice here.

roster.description: Construction frame of the warband: size, gold and the member slots every profile must fill.

requires_variant_selection.description: When true the application must ask for a variant before the warband is usable.

member.description: One roster slot: how many models of a profile the warband must or may field.

profile_id.description: Profile declared in `profiles.yaml` of the same package.

maximum.description: Upper bound, or null when the source sets none beyond `roster.maximum_models`.

group_size.description: Size of one henchman group of this profile.

variant.description: One selectable variant of the warband.

starting_gold.description: Starting gold of this variant, when it differs from the band default.

profile_bonuses.description: Per-profile characteristic bonuses of the variant: `profile_id` → characteristic → bonus.
